ipa.financial_contracts.Definitions

API endpoint for Financial Contract analytics, that returns calculations relevant to each contract type.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts.Definitions.

Syntax

Definitions(
    *,
    universe: BaseFinancialContractsDefinition | list[BaseFinancialContractsDefinition],
    fields: OptStrStrs = None,
    pricing_parameters: dict = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
universe BaseFinancialContractsDefinition | list[BaseFinancialContractsDefinition] Yes Array of Financial Contract definitions.
fields OptStrStrs No None Array of requested fields. each requested field will represent a column of the tabular response. By default all relevant fields are returned.
pricing_parameters dict No None Pricing parameters that are specific to the financial contracts defined in universe.

Methods

get_data

Sends a request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

get_data(session: Session | None = None, async_mode: bool | None = None)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
async_mode bool | None No None

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

get_data_async

Sends an asynchronous request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

async get_data_async(
    session: Session | None = None,
    on_response: Callable | None = None,
    async_mode: bool | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
on_response Callable | None No None Callable function to process the retrieved data.
async_mode bool | None No None
closure str | None No None Closure parameters that will be returned with the response.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

Example

import lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts as ldf
option_definition = ldf.option.Definition(
    instrument_code="FCHI560000L1.p",
    underlying_type=ldf.option.UnderlyingType.ETI,
    fields=[
        "MarketValueInDealCcy",
        "DeltaPercent",
        "GammaPercent",
        "RhoPercent",
        "ThetaPercent",
        "VegaPercent",
        "ErrorCode",
        "ErrorMessage",
    ],
)
bond_definition = ldf.bond.Definition(
    issue_date="2002-02-28",
    end_date="2032-02-28",
    notional_ccy="USD",
    interest_payment_frequency="Annual",
    fixed_rate_percent=7,
    interest_calculation_method=ldf.bond.DayCountBasis.DCB_ACTUAL_ACTUAL
)
definition = ldf.Definitions(
   [
       bond_definition,
       option_definition
   ]
)
response = definition.get_data()
